metadata.description: Run micromagnetic simulations on your Mac and get answers, not output directories. Writes verified .mx3 scripts, runs them and shows the result, searches a parameter until a target is met, checks whether the mesh is fine enough to trust, matches against measured hysteresis data, and reproduces a paper's setup. Built on mumax3-ultrafast, the Apple Silicon Metal port.
